findings.title: markFindingsClosed writes index.json outside withClosedJsonLock — crash window leaves index/closed.json inconsistent
findings.detail: markFindingsClosed (batch) calls writeAuditIndex before acquiring withClosedJsonLock, creating a crash window between the two writes. If the process dies after writeAuditIndex but before the withClosedJsonLock block, index.json shows findings as closed/fixed while closed.json has no corresponding records. The singular markFindingClosed correctly holds the lock across both writes (AUDIT-IFleet-d651330f). The inconsistency means batch PR reconciliation during audit-ritual can corrupt the audit trail: findings appear closed in the index but regression detection based on closed.json will not find them.
findings.fix_sketch: Move writeAuditIndex(indexPath, index) from outside the withClosedJsonLock call to be the first statement inside the withClosedJsonLock callback, matching the singular markFindingClosed pattern at line 354.

notes: 3 pre-existing IMPORTANT findings remain open from prior runs (argv exposure, SprintId type change, ULID seeding) — all documented as deferred with rationale in index.json. Stale open_count in index.json corrected to 3.
